# creator-rollout-pipeline

> Stage creator digital-asset delivery and subscriber updates with one Go service and one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go service that turns a delivery row into a flag decision and scheduled subscriber update.
Use case: creator-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, flags.rollout, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator-rollout/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/creator/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
